metadata.title: What Wave–Particle Duality Actually Means
metadata.thing: the possibility wave replacing the ball-with-ripples cartoon
chapters: What we skipped, and your turn
metadata.long_title: What Wave–Particle Duality Actually Means — it's not a ball with ripples | Bear's Notes
metadata.description_blurb: In this video: why the ball-with-ripples cartoon is dimensionally impossible (the wave of a lab electron is tens of thousands of times wider than the 'ball' could be); two questions that get two different answers — stripes for 'how do you travel?', one whole dot for 'where are you?'; why 'secret route' and 'wave of stuff' both fail; the one honest picture — a wave of possibility, |ψ|²; and duality's real meaning: wave-shaped possibilities, particle-shaped results.
metadata.short_blurb: Duality without the ball-with-ripples cartoon. Full explainer on the channel.
